display.purpose: Game name and catalog headline. font-stretch 118%.

label.purpose: Panel heads, field labels, buttons. font-stretch 76%, uppercase.

shadows.name: box-picked-up
shadows.purpose: Hover or focus on a box.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Box turn (520ms), laminate sweep (720ms), ink bars (1100ms), hero settle (1400ms).

components.name: Stamp
components.description: Prints a state (unscored, offline, not found) instead of hiding it.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; color: #b4b3ad; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 76%; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.3rem 0.55rem 0.25rem; margin: 0; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 26%); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #f3f2ee; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-size: 0.78rem; font-stretch: 76%; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #f3f2ee; background: #f3f2ee; color: #0e0e0f; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f3f2ee; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px #0e0e0f; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Panel-filled field with a strong hairline border.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 3.25rem; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 26%); border-radius: 3px; background: #161617; color: #f3f2ee; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; padding-inline: 1rem; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 42%); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #f3f2ee; background: #1e1e20; outline: none; }

components.name: MiMMa Axis Row
components.description: One row of the spec panel: name, ticked track with ink bar, score.
components.css: .ds-axis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8rem 1fr 3.5rem; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 12%); padding-block: 1.25rem; color: #f3f2ee; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-axis-name { font-size: 1.125rem; font-stretch: 108%; font-weight: 800; } .ds-axis-track { display: block; height: 0.875rem; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 calc(10% - 1px), rgb(255 255 255 / 16%) calc(10% - 1px) 10%), rgb(255 255 255 / 5%); } .ds-axis-bar { display: block; width: 72%; height: 100%; background: #00a0e3; } .ds-axis-value { font-size: 1.75rem; font-stretch: 118%; font-weight: 850; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: Games are upright boxes on a dark shelf; a game page is the box back with a ruled spec panel. Three process inks carry the MiMMa axes, one spot orange marks the current game, and states print as condensed caps stamps. One family, Archivo Variable, at extended heavy and condensed caps.
keyCharacteristics: Portrait 2:3 box art with a 3D turn on hover and a shelf ledge.
Hairline rules and a 3px white top rule define panels; no filled cards.

rules.name: The Axis Ink Rule
rules.body: Cyan, magenta and yellow mean Micro, Meso and Macro. A surface that is not an axis does not get an ink.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Spot orange appears only on the current game: the picked-up spine and the reference tick.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Titles go extended heavy, panel heads and labels go condensed caps. No second family.

rules.name: The Shadows Belong To Objects Rule
rules.body: Only boxes, the ledge, the sticker and floating layers throw shadows.

dos: Do use cyan, magenta and yellow for Micro, Meso and Macro, in that order.
Do open panels with a 3px white top rule and divide rows with 1px hairlines.
Do keep corners at 3px (2px for stamps and badges).
Do use tabular-nums for scores, counts and dates.
Do keep a visible focus ring on every interactive element.
donts: Don't use spot orange for anything but the current game.
Don't spend an axis ink on a status or brand role.
Don't wrap games in rounded dark cards with pill badges.
Don't hide a missing score, offline dataset or missing image.
Don't add a second typeface or a middle width for headings.
Don't put shadows on panels, inputs or stamps.
